title: Hanunuo Mangyan ancestral domain approved after 19 years

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — After nearly two decades of waiting for formal recognition of their ancestral land, the Hanunuo Mangyan indigenous community in Mindoro has finally secured approval of its application for a Certificate of Recognition of Ancestral Domain (CRAD). The National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) on Wednesday announced that the approved application covers 41,508.95674
